title: Cyber defense tech company RedLattice plans to go public via the Bold Eagle Acquisition Corp. SPAC, in a deal valuing RedLattice at ~$1.25B including debt (Liana Baker/Bloomberg)
summary: Liana Baker / Bloomberg: Cyber defense tech company RedLattice plans to go public via the Bold Eagle Acquisition Corp. SPAC, in a deal valuing RedLattice at ~$1.25B including debt — Private equity-backed cyber defense technology firm RedLattice said it's going public via a merger with blank-check company Bold Eagle Acquisition Corp.
